This beans plot is small and rented, so I will manage it with what my household can afford and do by hand. For beans, I do not plan to buy chemical fertilizer, and I will use some manure or compost if I can get it. I will plant local seed, depend on the rains, and do most of the work with my family. I do not expect to use pesticide, and I will not hire labor unless there is a problem, so for now I count no hired days.
